profile.name: Giovanni Altieri
profile.tagline: I build backends with Java and Spring Boot: REST APIs, data modelling and enterprise applications.
about: I'm a Software Engineer with a degree in Computer Engineering, specialised in backend development with Java and Spring Boot.
I design REST APIs and relational databases, and work with Spring Data JPA, Hibernate and PostgreSQL, using Git, Docker and Agile methods.
I'm precise, committed to continuous learning and collaboration. I enjoy tackling complex problems and helping development teams build robust, high-quality solutions.

activities: Backend application development with Java and Spring Boot.
Design and implementation of REST APIs.
Domain modelling and persistence with Spring Data JPA, Hibernate and PostgreSQL.
Working with Product Owners, functional analysts and frontend developers.
Git, GitLab, Docker and Swagger/OpenAPI across the development cycle.
Analysing, debugging and fixing issues in enterprise environments.
